dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses /var/tmp/ file paths, LINE SEQUENTIAL files, and COPY with REPLACING
evidence: SELECT SPASCR-FILE ASSIGN FILE-NAME1 ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
no EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - accounting card input component (会計カード入力 J02)
purpose.summary: This program is the accounting card input component (J02) of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt system used by Japanese medical clinics. It handles patient information, insurance combinations, medical procedure accounting, and receipt data entry/editing. It reads/writes SPA (screen parameter area) files and calls numerous subprograms for patient lookup, insurance calculation, and receipt processing.

notable_features: 54 COPY statements referencing domain-specific copybooks (CPPTINF, CPSRYACT, CPHKNCOMBI, CPSRYACCT, CPSANTEI, etc.)
Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoding rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
SPA (Screen Parameter Area) pattern typical of ORCA
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (mojibake visible in the truncated source). This is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system for Japan. The program is a substantial production component with revision history dating from 2000-2002. No COMP-3 usage is notable for a financial/medical billing system; numeric fields use plain PIC 9.
